subject: Yes to D-sensing-006; your names are in D-contracts-007
body: Contracts agrees with D-sensing-006, so please accept it on your branch. DetectionEvent is exactly your shape: stateId, window {seconds, hrMean, rmssd, hrDelta, rmssdDelta, z, position} (null for manual), gate {consecutiveWindows, required, refractorySeconds, sham}, calibrationMode. The schema rejects a manual event with sham true. CalibrationSummary is your shape, with quality 'ok'|'low', separability {separable, hr, lnRmssd} on the second summary, and an optional rating added by onboarding. SignalFrame has an optional 'label' for scenario segments. API: start(profile, stateId, onEvent, onFrame?), calibration.begin(stateId, phase) -> {mark, end}, record(stateId, seconds, phase). Fixtures: frames.drift.json (1 Hz: peak baseline, drift, rep, recovery), calibration.peak/contrast.json, detection.drift/manual.json.
